bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, urllib.request, sys
p=pathlib.Path("deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt")
if not p.is_file():
    print("INLINE_PREFLIGHT=SECRET_PATH_NOT_FOUND")
    sys.exit(62)
t=p.read_text().strip()
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+t+"/getMe",timeout=15) as r:
        result=json.load(r)
except Exception:
    print("INLINE_PREFLIGHT=TELEGRAM_UNREACHABLE")
    sys.exit(63)
if not result.get("ok") or result.get("result",{}).get("username","").lower()!="gaybbs_bot":
    print("INLINE_PREFLIGHT=BOT_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
    sys.exit(64)
if result["result"].get("supports_inline_queries") is not True:
    print("INLINE_PREFLIGHT=BOTFATHER_SETINLINE_REQUIRED")
    sys.exit(65)
print("INLINE_PREFLIGHT=ENABLED")
PY
